Path 2: AgentCore Runtime

• Isolated container (ARM64/ECR)
• Claude Agent SDK inside microVM
• S3 Files mount (shared workspace)
• Session affinity (sticky microVM)
IAM & Security:
• SourceAccount confused deputy guard
• Scoped: anthropic.* models only
• Cross-region inference profiles

div.font:
Network
• No 0.0.0.0/0 ingress
• VPC Origin (private path)
• VPC Flow Logs enabled
• 7 VPC Endpoints
IAM
• Least-privilege S3 actions
• SourceAccount conditions
• No s3:* / bedrock:* wildcards
Encryption
• TLS 1.2+ everywhere
• Redis TLS: required
• Redis AUTH token
• S3 enforceSSL: true
• RDS encrypted at rest
WAF
• Rate limit: 1000/5min
• AWS CRS + SQLi
• KnownBadInputs
• IP Reputation List
Reliability
• Circuit breaker + rollback
• Graceful shutdown 120s
• Multi-AZ (all layers)
• Log retention: 90 days
